reader.requirement: At --std 85, OPEN EXTEND naming a relative file must be refused unless the file's access mode is sequential (ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL or no ACCESS MODE clause, which defaults to sequential); RANDOM and DYNAMIC access are refused, and a legal EXTEND appends records after the existing ones.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel picks the citation of the FORMAT-clause I-O arm only (2002/2014/2023); the EXTEND access-mode arm has no edition test

reader.edition-search: Read CheckOpenModeForFile and BindOpen's call site; grep -n 'EXTEND|Extend' VersionConformancePass.cs found no OPEN EXTEND gate. The access-mode arm (mode is Extend && AccessMode is not Sequential) is edition-blind.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for this rule (the 2023 rule adds a LINAGE conjunct that the 1985 Relative I-O rule lacks, but a 1985 relative file cannot carry LINAGE, so the conjunct is vacuous here; the diagnostic cites ISO §2023:14.9.27.3 SR2 at --std 85)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers ACCESS RANDOM on a relative file; DYNAMIC, the default access mode, the legal run-time append and the failed open are not in it (probed here)

probes.printed: error COBOL2372: OPEN EXTEND 'FR' — the file's access mode is RANDOM; EXTEND requires sequential access (ISO §2023:14.9.27.3 SR2)
error COBOL2372 ... access mode is DYNAMIC
EXT 00 | WR 00 RK 0002 | AAAA 0001 | BBBB 0002 | EOF
probes.expected: accepted; record appended as relative record 2
accepted: no ACCESS clause = sequential access
unavailable non-optional file: open unsuccessful (Table 1), subsequent WRITE fails with a not-open status

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1  (4.4.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: The single access-mode test refuses RANDOM and DYNAMIC and admits sequential (written or defaulted) at --std 85, and the legal EXTEND appends at run time. Diagnostic-face observation: COBOL2372 cites ISO §2023:14.9.27.3 SR2 at --std 85 instead of the 1985 Relative I-O rule.
reader.at-2023: not run separately: the arm is edition-blind

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VIII.4.4 whole (format: INPUT/OUTPUT/I-O/EXTEND, no NO REWIND or LOCK phrases for a relative file; SR1; Table 1; Table 2) and StatementValidation.cs#CheckOpenModeForFile's access-mode arm. Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-07/c4), aimed at what the reader did not try: multi.cob 'OPEN INPUT FB EXTEND FA FC' and 'OPEN EXTEND FA FB' (several phrases and several files per phrase) -> COBOL2372 for exactly the DYNAMIC FC and the RANDOM FB, none for the sequential FA, so each operand of the series is screened; extrn.cob an EXTERNAL relative FD with RANDOM -> COBOL2372; nestg.cob a GLOBAL DYNAMIC relative file opened EXTEND in a contained program -> COBOL2372 (the screen follows the file, not the program); opt.cob OPTIONAL relative sequential file absent -> 'EXT 05 | WR 00 RK 0001 | CCCC 0001' (Table 1 'Open causes the file to be created', record appended as 1); lock.cob OPEN EXTEND FR WITH NO REWIND on a relative file -> COBOL1802 (a form the 1985 relative format does not print, refused). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1  (4.4.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR1  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1'. Diagnostic face only: COBOL2372 cites ISO §2023:14.9.27.3 SR2 at --std 85.
